DECISION-FIRST AI TEXT KIT | Ahmadreza Samadi

1. Extract the entire ZIP. Open Decision-First-AI-Blank.txt in any text editor.
2. Save a private working copy; fill the ten fields below their prompts.
3. The separate Fictional-Example file illustrates the existing card.
   Do not copy its invented answers into actual experiment records.
4. Read Reading-Notes.txt before using or adapting the example.

No Python, PDF editor, account or installation is needed to edit these texts.
No experiment has been run and no company/customer results are represented.
Unknown outcomes are not zero outcomes. Keep completed records private.
This package adds a plain-text format, not a new method or validated test.
It does not change or replace the existing fillable PDF or interactive guide.
Prepared with AI assistance. No new blanket reuse licence is asserted.
